title: The Last Hurrah Effect: End-of-Period Temporal Landmarks Increase Optimism and Financial Risk-Taking
eligible_reason: Not a DiD or event-study design. Archival analysis compares bid-level risk-taking across weekdays and calendar landmarks (Fridays, month end, year end, pre-holiday) on the Prosper P2P lending platform, plus lab experiments.
design_notes: JMR 62(2), 2025. Prosper bid-level data; outcome = reserve interest rate of the listing a lender bids on; regressor = End of Period indicator (Friday baseline); lender fixed effects plus lender, listing and platform controls (Equations 1-2); SEs clustered by lender. The Bertrand-Duflo-Mullainathan citation concerns clustering. No units adopt a treatment at unit-specific dates.
screener_notes: Not eligible. No policy or treatment adoption; the 'treatment' is recurring calendar position. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only.
